tex_content.html:
For a complete flow with bounded nonnegative curvature operator on $[t_1,t_2]$ and points $x_1,x_2$, \[ \log \left( rac{R(x_2,t_2)}{R(x_1,t_1)} ight) \ge - rac12 rac{d_{t_1}^2(x_2,x_1)}{t_2-t_1}. \]
Proof

↗ thm:hamilton-harnack-inequality \sketch Take $\chi =- abla \log R/2$ in the differential Harnack inequality and divide by $R$ to obtain $\partial _t\log R-| abla \log R|^2/2\ge 0$. Integrate along the constant-speed $g(t_1)$-geodesic from $x_1$ to $x_2$; completing the square and using $\Ric \ge 0$ yields the stated distance-energy bound.

\label{Harnack2}
For a complete flow with bounded nonnegative curvature operator on
$[t_1,t_2]$ and points $x_1,x_2$,
\[
\log\left(\frac{R(x_2,t_2)}{R(x_1,t_1)}\right)
\ge-\frac12\frac{d_{t_1}^2(x_2,x_1)}{t_2-t_1}.
\]
\end{theorem}
